title: Validation Service — Vendor Engagement
description: How software vendors use the Validation Service to test their own exporters: who, how much, how continuously, with which builds. Usage, not quality. Built 2026-09-30 for the bSI Summit request; research context in vendor_fixes_investigation/RESEARCH_NOTE_v2.md.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Granularity
list.description: Time bucket for the trend panels; the running (incomplete) bucket is excluded.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query:
SELECT c.name FROM ifc_company c JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.company_id = c.id JOIN ifc_model m ON m.uploaded_by_id = ai.user_id JOIN ifc_validation_request r ON r.model_id = m.id
WHERE ai.is_vendor AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Vendor organisations
panels.description: How many vendor organisations test on the service?

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.created, r.deleted, m.uploaded_by_id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS vendor,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', ''), NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name) AS orig,
         (COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'version','')) AS hdr
  FROM ifc_validation_request r
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id
  JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
  JOIN ifc_company c ON c.id = ai.company_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND $__timeFilter(r.created)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) FROM v) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ai.company_id) FROM ifc_validation_request r JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
        WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND ai.company_id IS NOT NULL) AS "all time"

panels.title: Uploads by vendor accounts
panels.description: How much of all traffic comes from vendors?

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.created, r.deleted, m.uploaded_by_id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS vendor,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', ''), NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name) AS orig,
         (COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'version','')) AS hdr
  FROM ifc_validation_request r
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id
  JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
  JOIN ifc_company c ON c.id = ai.company_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND $__timeFilter(r.created)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) AS "vendor uploads", ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_validation_request r WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(r.created)), 0), 1) AS "share of all uploads"

panels.title: Pre-release testing
panels.description: Do vendors test before they release?

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.created, r.deleted, m.uploaded_by_id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS vendor,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', ''), NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name) AS orig,
         (COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'version','')) AS hdr
  FROM ifc_validation_request r
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id
  JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
  JOIN ifc_company c ON c.id = ai.company_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND $__timeFilter(r.created)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hdr ~* '(alpha|beta|\mrc[0-9]*\M|prerelease|pre-release|preview|nightly|\mdev\M|-dev|build 0|partner release)') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "pre-release builds", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "later deleted" FROM v

panels.title: Uploads per $bucket: vendor accounts vs other users
panels.description: Is vendor testing growing along with the service?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', r.created) AS time,
       CASE WHEN ai.is_vendor AND ai.company_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'vendor accounts' ELSE 'other users' END AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::float AS uploads
FROM ifc_validation_request r JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id LEFT JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(r.created) AND date_trunc('$bucket', r.created) < date_trunc('$bucket', now())
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Active vendor organisations and accounts per $bucket
panels.description: How many vendors are active each month?

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.created, r.deleted, m.uploaded_by_id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS vendor,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', ''), NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name) AS orig,
         (COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'version','')) AS hdr
  FROM ifc_validation_request r
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id
  JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
  JOIN ifc_company c ON c.id = ai.company_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND $__timeFilter(r.created)
)
SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', created) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT company_id)::float AS "vendor organisations", COUNT(DISTINCT uploaded_by_id)::float AS "vendor accounts"
FROM v WHERE date_trunc('$bucket', created) < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vendor organisations with an account (cumulative)
panels.description: How many vendor organisations have joined so far?

targets.rawSql:
WITH acc AS (SELECT u.date_joined, ai.company_id FROM auth_user u JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = u.id WHERE ai.is_vendor AND ai.company_id IS NOT NULL),
org AS (SELECT company_id, MIN(date_joined) AS first_joined FROM acc GROUP BY 1),
m AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', (SELECT MIN(date_joined) FROM acc)), date_trunc('month', now()), interval '1 month') AS month)
SELECT m.month AS time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org WHERE first_joined < m.month + interval '1 month')::float AS "vendor organisations with an account"
FROM m WHERE $__timeFilter(m.month) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vendor accounts (cumulative)

WITH acc AS (SELECT u.date_joined FROM auth_user u JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = u.id WHERE ai.is_vendor AND ai.company_id IS NOT NULL),

panels.title: Vendor organisations ranked by uploads (time range)
panels.description: Which vendors use the service most, and how?

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.created, r.deleted, m.uploaded_by_id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS vendor,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', ''), NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name) AS orig,
         (COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'version','')) AS hdr
  FROM ifc_validation_request r
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id
  JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
  JOIN ifc_company c ON c.id = ai.company_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND $__timeFilter(r.created)
)
SELECT vendor,
       COUNT(*) AS uploads,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_validation_request r WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(r.created)), 0), 1) AS "share of all %",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created >= now() - interval '12 months') AS "last 12 months",
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT uploaded_by_id) < 5 THEN '<5' ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT uploaded_by_id)::text END AS accounts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', created)) AS "active months",
       to_char(MIN(created), 'YYYY-MM') AS first, to_char(MAX(created), 'YYYY-MM') AS last,
       COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(orig, '')) AS "exporter strings (upper bound on versions)",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hdr ~* '(alpha|beta|\mrc[0-9]*\M|prerelease|pre-release|preview|nightly|\mdev\M|-dev|build 0|partner release)') / COUNT(*), 0) AS "pre-release %",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted) / COUNT(*), 0) AS "deleted %"
FROM v GROUP BY vendor ORDER BY uploads DESC

panels.title: What the selected vendors upload: originating systems ($vendor)
panels.description: Do they upload their own exporter, or other vendors' files?

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.created, r.deleted, m.uploaded_by_id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS vendor,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', ''), NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name) AS orig,
         (COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version','') || ' ' || COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'version','')) AS hdr
  FROM ifc_validation_request r
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id
  JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id
  JOIN ifc_company c ON c.id = ai.company_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND ai.is_vendor AND $__timeFilter(r.created)
)
SELECT vendor, COALESCE(NULLIF(orig, ''), '(no header)') AS "originating system (raw header, or tool name when no header was stored)", COUNT(*) AS uploads,
       to_char(MIN(created), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS first, to_char(MAX(created), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS last
FROM v WHERE vendor IN (${vendor:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY uploads DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Most-validated tools, all uploaders (time range)
panels.description: Which tools do users validate most?

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT m.uploaded_by_id, ai.is_vendor, ai.company_id,
    CASE WHEN m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version' ~* 'IFC-manager for SketchUp' THEN 'SketchUp IFC Manager' END AS pre_s,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(trim(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[-(,]?\s*[vV]?[0-9].*$', '')), ''),
      CASE WHEN m.header_validation->>'originating_system' ~ '^\s*[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{4}' OR m.header_validation->>'originating_system' ~ '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+\s*-\s*(Exporter|IFC)\M' THEN 'Autodesk Revit' END,
      NULLIF(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', '^IFC file generated by ', ''), '\s*[-(,]?\s*[vV]?[0-9].*$', '')), ''),
      CASE WHEN m.header_validation IS NULL THEN '(unknown: no header stored)' WHEN COALESCE(m.header_validation->>'originating_system', '') = '' THEN '(unknown: header names no software)' ELSE '(unknown: header not parsed)' END) AS s
  FROM ifc_validation_request r JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = r.model_id LEFT JOIN ifc_user_additional_info ai ON ai.user_id = m.uploaded_by_id LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(r.created))
SELECT CASE WHEN pre_s IS NOT NULL THEN pre_s
            WHEN s ~* 'ifc.?manager' THEN 'SketchUp IFC Manager'
            WHEN s ~* '^(autodesk\s*-?\s*)?revit' THEN 'Autodesk Revit'
            WHEN s ~* '^(graphisoft\s+)?archicad' THEN 'Graphisoft Archicad'
            WHEN s ~* '^(autodesk\s+)?civil$|^autodesk ifc$' THEN 'Autodesk Civil 3D (incl. IFC 4.3 plug-in)'
            WHEN s ~* '^(trimble\s+)?quadri' THEN 'Trimble Quadri'
            WHEN s ~* '^redacted$' THEN '(unknown: name redacted)'
            ELSE s END AS "tool (name stem, approximate)",
       COUNT(*) AS files,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT uploaded_by_id) < 5 THEN '<5' ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT uploaded_by_id)::text END AS "uploader accounts",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vendor AND company_id IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 0) AS "from vendor accounts %"
FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY files DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: What counts as a vendor here, and what did the research find?

options.content:
**Vendor account** = an account buildingSMART flagged as a vendor, with a company. The flag is hand-maintained, so every number here is a lower bound. **Uploads** include ones the uploader later deleted. Account counts under 5 show as *<5*. The organisation count has been flat since mid-2025: the established vendors are all on board; newcomers are small makers (about 30 to 40) not yet on the hand-kept list. **This measures use of the service, not the quality of anyone's exports.** Internal; name vendors publicly only with their consent.

*The research summary with results per maker is internal and is not stored in the repository.*
